title: Physical Activity, Mediterranean Diet and Maternity Blues: a Multidisciplinary Approach
official: Physical Activity, Mediterranean Diet and Maternity Blues: a Multidisciplinary Approach
summary: This study aims to evaluate the levels of physical activity, sedentary time, eating habits, and emotional well-being in a group of women after giving birth.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Female subjects, aged ≥18 years and with adequate knowledge of spoken and written Italian.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Presence of pathologies that contraindicate the practice of physical activity.
